- Trains in the best free train area your rebirth unlocks - the gamepass areas are filtered out
- Farms stage 27, the deepest one. That is the whole game: stage 5 ore forged a Train 500 weapon, stage 27 ore forged Train 150,000,000 - one forge, 300,000 times stronger
- Returns after every run, because ore only reaches your inventory once you go back
- Forges weapons AND armor and equips the best, valued exactly the way the game itself computes gear
- Sells the weaker gear for coins and buys the Ore Bag, Train and Luck upgrades
- Claims every Index entry and every index rank reward
- Runs the Frozen Tower - all 30 rounds on one ticket - for enchant stones, claims the daily ticket and enchants your worn gear

- Auto rebirth and anti-AFK

MOBILE
Works on PC and mobile - the panel asks once and scales itself, and it speaks German, English and Russian. Every setting survives a rejoin.

HOW TO RUN
1. Open [Races]+1 Loot To Forge
2. Paste the loader into your executor
3. Execute - the panel opens by itself
4. Press RightShift to show or hide it

No key, no ads, and it never spends Robux - paid train areas, rebirth skips, race rolls and ticket packs all stay shut.

scripts.script:
-- Load Rayfield UI
local success, Rayfield = pcall(function() return loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://sirius.menu/rayfield'))() end)
if not success or not Rayfield then return end

local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
   Name = "Dinosaur Game Hub | Rayfield UI",
   LoadingTitle = "Loading Hub...",
   LoadingSubtitle = "by Custom Script",
   ConfigurationSaving = { Enabled = false },
   KeySystem = false,
})

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local MainTab = Window:CreateTab("Main", "home")
local FarmsTab = Window:CreateTab("Farms", "package")
local CombatTab = Window:CreateTab("Combat", "crosshair")
local VisualsTab = Window:CreateTab("Visuals", "eye")

-- Helper: Multi-Prompt Spam
local function spamPrompts(container)
   pcall(function()
       for _, desc in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do
           if desc:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
               desc.HoldDuration = 0
               desc:InputHoldBegin()
               task.wait(0.01)
               desc:InputHoldEnd()
           elseif desc:IsA("ClickDetector") and fireclickdetector then
               fireclickdetector(desc)
           end
       end
   end)
end

-- 1. INFINITE STAMINA
local infStamina = false
MainTab:CreateToggle({
   Name = "Infinite Stamina (Max + Remote Spam)",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(v)
      infStamina = v
      task.spawn(function()
         while infStamina do
            pcall(function()
               local char = LocalPlayer.Character
               local stats = char and char:FindFirstChild("PlayerStats")
               if stats then
                  for _, f in ipairs(stats:GetChildren()) do
                     local m = f:FindFirstChild("MaxStamina") or f:FindFirstChild("Stamina")
                     if m then m.Value = 999999 end
                  end
               end
               local ev = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Events")
               local rs = ev and ev:FindFirstChild("InGame") and ev.InGame:FindFirstChild("RegenStam")
               if rs then rs:FireServer("10000") end
            end)
            task.wait(0.2)
         end
      end)
   end,
})

-- 2. LOOT BUSH FARM
local bushFarm = false
FarmsTab:CreateToggle({
   Name = "Loot Bush Farm (Tier 1-3)",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(v)
      bushFarm = v
      task.spawn(function()
         while bushFarm do
            pcall(function()
               local root = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
               if root then
                  for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                     if not bushFarm then break end
                     if obj:IsA("Model") and (obj.Name:match("Tier[1-3]LootBush")) then
                        local pp = obj.PrimaryPart or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                        if pp then
                           root.CFrame = pp.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
                           spamPrompts(obj)
                           task.wait(0.1)
                        end
                     end
                  end
               end
            end)
            task.wait(0.2)
         end
      end)
   end,
})

-- 3. CRATE AUTOFARM (Crates + XPCrate + Title Check)
local crateFarm = false
FarmsTab:CreateToggle({
   Name = "Crate Farm (Includes XPCrate)",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(v)
      crateFarm = v
      task.spawn(function()
         while crateFarm do
            pcall(function()
               local root = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
               if root then
                  for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                     if not crateFarm then break end
                     if obj:IsA("Model") and (obj.Name:match("Crate")) then
                        local timerGui = obj:FindFirstChild("Timer")
                        local valid = false
                        if timerGui then
                           local title = timerGui:FindFirstChild("Title", true) or timerGui:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel", true)
                           if title and (title:IsA("TextLabel") or title:IsA("TextBox")) then
                              local txt = tostring(title.Text)
                              if txt == "-1" or txt == "" then valid = true end
                           end
                        else
                           valid = true
                        end
                        if valid then
                           local pp = obj.PrimaryPart or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                           if pp then
                              local orig = root.CFrame
                              while obj.Parent and crateFarm do
                                 root.CFrame = pp.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
                                 spamPrompts(obj)
                                 task.wait(0.05)
                              end
                              task.wait(0.1)
                              if root then root.CFrame = orig end
                           end
                        end
                     end
                  end
               end
            end)
            task.wait(0.3)
         end
      end)
   end,
})

-- 4. FLOWER FARMS
local function flowerFarm(name, label, defWait)
   local enabled, cWait = false, defWait
   FarmsTab:CreateToggle({
      Name = label, CurrentValue = false,
      Callback = function(v)
         enabled = v
         task.spawn(function()
            while enabled do
               pcall(function()
                  local root = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                  if root then
                     for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                        if not enabled then break end
                        if obj.Name == name then
                           local tp = obj:IsA("Model") and (obj.PrimaryPart or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")) or (obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj)
                           if tp then
                              root.CFrame = tp.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
                              spamPrompts(obj:IsA("Model") and obj or obj.Parent)
                              for _, p in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                                 if p:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and p.Parent:IsA("BasePart") and (p.Parent.Position - root.Position).Magnitude < 10 then
                                    p.HoldDuration = 0 p:InputHoldBegin() task.wait(0.01) p:InputHoldEnd()
                                 end
                              end
                              task.wait(cWait)
                           end
                        end
                     end
                  end
               end)
               task.wait(0.05)
            end
         end)
      end,
   })
   FarmsTab:CreateInput({
      Name = label .. " Delay", PlaceholderText = tostring(defWait), RemoveTextAfterFocusLost = false,
      Callback = function(t) local n = tonumber(t) if n and n >= 0 then cWait = n end end,
   })
end

flowerFarm("GrowthFlower", "Growth Flower Farm", 0.01)
flowerFarm("HuntingFlower", "Hunting Flower Farm", 0.05)
flowerFarm("XPFlower", "XP Flower Farm", 0.05)

-- 5. INSTANT PROMPTS
MainTab:CreateToggle({
   Name = "Instant Proximity Prompts", CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(v)
      task.spawn(function()
         while v do
            pcall(function() for _, p in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do if p:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then p.HoldDuration = 0 end end end)
            task.wait(0.5)
         end
      end)
   end,
})

-- 6. SPEED CHANGER
local speedEn, tSpeed = false, 90
MainTab:CreateToggle({
   Name = "Enable WalkSpeed Changer", CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(v) speedEn = v if not v then pcall(function() LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16 end) end end,
})
MainTab:CreateInput({
   Name = "WalkSpeed Value", PlaceholderText = "90", RemoveTextAfterFocusLost = false,
   Callback = function(t) local n = tonumber(t) if n then tSpeed = n end end,
})
task.spawn(function()
   while true do
      if speedEn then pcall(function() LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = tSpeed end) end
      task.wait(0.1)
   end
end)

-- 7. SUPER JUMP
local sjGui
MainTab:CreateToggle({
   Name = "Deinonychus Super Jump", CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(v)
      if v then
         if not sjGui then
            sjGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", CoreGui)
            sjGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
            local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", sjGui)
            btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 130, 0, 50) btn.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -65, 0.8, 0)
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35) btn.Text = "SUPER JUMP"
            btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) btn.TextSize = 16 btn.Draggable = true
            Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
            btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
               pcall(function() ReplicatedStorage.Events.AbilityDump.SuperJump:FireServer(120) end)
            end)
         else sjGui.Enabled = true end
      elseif sjGui then sjGui.Enabled = false end
   end,
})

-- 8. HITBOX EXPANDER
local hbEn, hbSize = false, 5
CombatTab:CreateToggle({
   Name = "Enable Hitbox Expander", CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(v) hbEn = v if not v then pcall(function()
      for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
         if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            p.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 1)
            p.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Transparency = 1
         end
      end
   end) end end,
})
CombatTab:CreateInput({
   Name = "Hitbox Size", PlaceholderText = "5", RemoveTextAfterFocusLost = false,
   Callback = function(t) local n = tonumber(t) if n then hbSize = n end end,
})
task.spawn(function()
   while true do
      if hbEn then
         pcall(function()
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
               if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                  local r = p.Character.HumanoidRootPart
                  r.Size = Vector3.new(hbSize, hbSize, hbSize)
                  r.Transparency = 0.7 r.CanCollide = false
               end
            end
         end)
      end
      task.wait(0.5)
   end
end)

-- 9. INVISIBLE
CombatTab:CreateButton({
   Name = "Invisible (By Punisher)",
   Callback = function() pcall(function() loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-Universal-Invisible-by-PUNISHER-116208"))() end) end,
})

-- 10. ESP & TRACERS
local espEn = false
local espC, trcC = {}, {}
VisualsTab:CreateToggle({
   Name = "Player ESP & 3D Tracers", CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(v)
      espEn = v
      if not v then
         for _, t in pairs(espC) do pcall(function() t:Remove() end) end espC = {}
         for _, l in pairs(trcC) do pcall(function() l:Remove() end) end trcC = {}
      end
   end,
})

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
   if not espEn then return end
   pcall(function()
      local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
      local lChar = LocalPlayer.Character
      local lRoot = lChar and lChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
         if p ~= LocalPlayer then
            local char, root, hum = p.Character, p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"), p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if root and hum and Drawing then
               local tObj = espC[p] or Drawing.new("Text")
               if not espC[p] then tObj.Visible = false tObj.Center = true tObj.Outline = true tObj.Size = 14 espC[p] = tObj end
               local lObj = trcC[p] or Drawing.new("Line")
               if not trcC[p] then lObj.Visible = false lObj.Thickness = 1.5 lObj.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 128) trcC[p] = lObj end
               
               local vec, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
               local rVec, rOnScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position)
               if onScreen and lRoot then
                  tObj.Text = string.format("%s\n[%d/%dHP] | [%dm]", p.Name, hum.Health, hum.MaxHealth, math.floor((lRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude))
                  tObj.Position = Vector2.new(vec.X, vec.Y) tObj.Visible = true
                  if rOnScreen then
                     lObj.From = Vector2.new(cam.ViewportSize.X / 2, cam.ViewportSize.Y)
                     lObj.To = Vector2.new(rVec.X, rVec.Y) lObj.Visible = true
                  else lObj.Visible = false end
               else tObj.Visible = false lObj.Visible = false end
            else
               if espC[p] then espC[p].Visible = false end
               if trcC[p] then trcC[p].Visible = false end
            end
         end
      end
   end)
end)

local function sendChatMessage(msg)
    pcall(function()
        if generalChannel then
            generalChannel:SendAsync(msg)
        elseif sayMessageEvent then
            sayMessageEvent:FireServer(msg, "All")
        end
    end)
end

local function getRandomWord()
    return words[math.random(1, #words)]
end

local function getRandomTractorWord()
    return tractorWords[math.random(1, #tractorWords)]
end

-- नाम और इंडेक्स को अपडेट करने के लिए फिक्स
local function buildFinalMsg()
    local border = ""
    if borderMode == 1 then
        border = string.rep("/////===", 10)
    elseif borderMode == 2 then
        border = string.rep("~~~~~===", 10)
    elseif borderMode == 3 then
        border = string.rep("@_-", 30)
    else
        border = string.rep("/////+++", 10)
    end
    
    local w1 = getRandomWord()
    local w2 = getRandomWord()
    local w3 = getRandomWord()
    local w4 = getRandomWord()
    local t1 = getRandomTractorWord()
    
    local currentHater = haterList[haterIndex]
    if not currentHater or currentHater == "" then
        currentHater = "HATER 1"
    end
    
    haterIndex = (haterIndex % #haterList) + 1
    local cleanName = string.upper(currentHater)
    
    local msg = string.format("%s\n[⚡ %s] TMX ME %s %s ROKET BOOM %s %s TRACTOR %s [MIN AND ARB ON TOP]", border, cleanName, w1, w2, w3, w4, t1)
    
    -- सेफ्टी चेकर: लिमिट क्रॉस होते ही 'TRACTOR' शब्द अपने आप गायब हो जाएगा ताकि चैट में रुकावट न आए
    if #msg > 185 then
        msg = string.format("%s\n[⚡ %s] TMX ME %s %s ROKET BOOM %s %s %s [MIN AND ARB ON TOP]", border, cleanName, w1, w2, w3, w4, t1)
    end
    
    return msg
end

scripts.script:
-- Roblox 客户端性能优化与 FPS 提升脚本
-- 目标：降级 Lighting 渲染、强制锁定画质 Level 1，削减 GPU/CPU 负担

local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local UserSettings = UserSettings():GetService("UserGameSettings")
local RenderingSettings = settings().Rendering

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. 强制锁死画质等级为 Level 1（忽略并覆盖用户的修改）
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local function lockQualityToLevel1()
    pcall(function()
        RenderingSettings.QualityLevel = Enum.QualityLevel.Level01
        UserSettings.SavedQualityLevel = Enum.SavedQualityLevel.QualityLevel1
    end)
end

-- 立即执行一次画质重置
lockQualityToLevel1()

-- 监听画质变更事件，防止玩家在设置菜单中手动修改画质
UserSettings:GetPropertyChangedSignal("SavedQualityLevel"):Connect(lockQualityToLevel1)
pcall(function()
    RenderingSettings:GetPropertyChangedSignal("QualityLevel"):Connect(lockQualityToLevel1)
end)

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. Lighting 光照与风格优化
--------------------------------------------------------------------
pcall(function()
    -- 1) 设置光照风格为 Soft (扁平化光照，关闭高阶法线与高精度动态阴影计算)
    Lighting.LightingStyle = Enum.LightingStyle.Soft

    -- 2) 设置光照技术为 Compatibility (兼容/支持模式)
    local success = pcall(function()
        Lighting.Technology = Enum.Technology.Compatibility
    end)
    if not success then
        -- 若引擎或场景限制不支持 Compatibility，退回最省资源的 Voxel (体素光照)
        Lighting.Technology = Enum.Technology.Voxel
    end

    -- 3) 关闭全局阴影计算
    Lighting.GlobalShadows = false

    -- 4) 禁用 Lighting 下的所有后期特效 (Bloom, Blur, DepthOfField, SunRays 等)
    for _, effect in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
        if effect:IsA("PostEffect") then
            effect.Enabled = false
        end
    end
end)

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 3. 场景物体与粒子渲染削减（进一步降低 CPU/GPU 开销）
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local function optimizeInstance(inst)
    if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
        inst.CastShadow = false -- 禁用场景物体的单个投影计算
    elseif inst:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or inst:IsA("Trail") or inst:IsA("Smoke") or inst:IsA("Fire") then
        inst.Enabled = false -- 禁用粒子与尾迹渲染
    end
end

-- 清理当前地图所有物体
for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
    optimizeInstance(obj)
end

-- 监听后续动态生成的物体
workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(optimizeInstance)

scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

------------------------------------------------
-- LIMPEZA
------------------------------------------------

local oldGui = playerGui:FindFirstChild("SpiderUI")
if oldGui then
	oldGui:Destroy()
end

------------------------------------------------
-- CONFIGURAÇÕES
------------------------------------------------

local SWING_ANIM = "rbxassetid://507767968"
local SWING_SOUND = "rbxassetid://1284846268"
local ZIP_SOUND = "rbxassetid://9084017080"

-- ANIMAÇÃO DE ESCALADA R15
local CLIMB_ANIM = "rbxassetid://507765644"

local swinging = false
local swingStep = 1
local zipStep = 1

local climbing = false
local climbEnabled = false

local swingConn = nil
local swingAnchor = nil
local swingRope = nil
local swingTrack = nil

local climbConn = nil
local climbTrack = nil
local climbVelocity = nil
local climbAlign = nil
local climbAttachment = nil

local webs = {}
local ikList = {}
local gripAtt = nil

------------------------------------------------
-- PERSONAGEM
------------------------------------------------

local function getParts()
	local char = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()

	local hrp = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

	return char, hrp, hum
end

local function applyJump(char)
	local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

	hum.UseJumpPower = true
	hum.JumpPower = 100
end

if player.Character then
	task.spawn(applyJump, player.Character)
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
	task.wait(0.5)
	applyJump(char)
end)

------------------------------------------------
-- ANIMAÇÃO
------------------------------------------------

local function getAnimator(hum)
	local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")

	if not animator then
		animator = Instance.new("Animator")
		animator.Parent = hum
	end

	return animator
end

------------------------------------------------
-- MÃOS
------------------------------------------------

local function getHand(char, side)

	if side == "Right" then
		return char:FindFirstChild("RightHand")
			or char:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
	end

	return char:FindFirstChild("LeftHand")
		or char:FindFirstChild("Left Arm")
end

------------------------------------------------
-- BRAÇOS
------------------------------------------------

local function getArmRoot(char, side)

	if side == "Right" then
		return char:FindFirstChild("RightUpperArm")
			or char:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
			or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
	end

	return char:FindFirstChild("LeftUpperArm")
		or char:FindFirstChild("Left Arm")
		or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
end

------------------------------------------------
-- LIMPAR TEIAS
------------------------------------------------

local function clearWebs()

	for _, obj in ipairs(webs) do
		if obj and obj.Parent then
			obj:Destroy()
		end
	end

	table.clear(webs)
end

------------------------------------------------
-- LIMPAR IK
------------------------------------------------

local function clearIK()

	for _, ik in ipairs(ikList) do
		if ik and ik.Parent then
			ik:Destroy()
		end
	end

	table.clear(ikList)
end

------------------------------------------------
-- SOM
------------------------------------------------

local function playSound(hrp, id)

	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")

	sound.SoundId = id
	sound.Volume = 2
	sound.Parent = hrp

	sound:Play()

	Debris:AddItem(sound, 3)
end

------------------------------------------------
-- CRIAR TEIA
------------------------------------------------

local function addWebFromHand(char, targetAtt, side)

	local hand = getHand(char, side)

	if not hand or not targetAtt then
		return
	end

	local handAtt = Instance.new("Attachment")
	handAtt.Name = "WebHandAttachment"
	handAtt.Parent = hand

	local beam = Instance.new("Beam")

	beam.Attachment0 = targetAtt
	beam.Attachment1 = handAtt

	beam.Width0 = 0.18
	beam.Width1 = 0.10

	beam.Color = ColorSequence.new(
		Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
	)

	beam.LightEmission = 1
	beam.FaceCamera = true

	beam.Parent = hand

	table.insert(webs, beam)
	table.insert(webs, handAtt)
end

------------------------------------------------
-- IK DO BRAÇO
------------------------------------------------

local function attachArm(char, hum, side, targetAtt)

	local hand = getHand(char, side)
	local root = getArmRoot(char, side)

	if not hand or not root or not targetAtt then
		return
	end

	local ik = Instance.new("IKControl")

	ik.Name = "WebArmIK_" .. side
	ik.Type = Enum.IKControlType.Position

	ik.EndEffector = hand
	ik.ChainRoot = root
	ik.Target = targetAtt

	ik.Weight = 1
	ik.SmoothTime = 0.08

	ik.Parent = hum

	table.insert(ikList, ik)
end

------------------------------------------------
-- UI
------------------------------------------------

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")

gui.Name = "SpiderUI"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true

gui.Parent = playerGui

------------------------------------------------
-- BOTÃO DE ESCALAR
------------------------------------------------

local btnClimb = Instance.new("ImageButton")

btnClimb.Name = "BtnClimb"

btnClimb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(75,75)

btnClimb.Position = UDim2.new(
	0.68,
	0,
	0.57,
	0
)

btnClimb.BackgroundColor3 =
	Color3.fromRGB(190,25,25)

btnClimb.Image =
	"rbxassetid://76038791676557"

btnClimb.ScaleType =
	Enum.ScaleType.Fit

btnClimb.Parent = gui

local climbCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

climbCorner.CornerRadius =
	UDim.new(1,0)

climbCorner.Parent = btnClimb

local climbStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")

climbStroke.Color =
	Color3.fromRGB(0,110,255)

climbStroke.Thickness = 4

climbStroke.Parent = btnClimb

------------------------------------------------
-- BOTÃO BALANÇO
------------------------------------------------

local btnSwing = Instance.new("ImageButton")

btnSwing.Name = "BtnSwing"

btnSwing.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(75,75)

btnSwing.Position = UDim2.new(
	0.68,
	0,
	0.78,
	0
)

btnSwing.BackgroundColor3 =
	Color3.fromRGB(190,25,25)

btnSwing.Image =
	"rbxassetid://124599639623520"

btnSwing.ScaleType =
	Enum.ScaleType.Fit

btnSwing.Parent = gui

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")

corner.CornerRadius =
	UDim.new(1,0)

corner.Parent = btnSwing

local swingStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")

swingStroke.Color =
	Color3.fromRGB(0,110,255)

swingStroke.Thickness = 4

swingStroke.Parent = btnSwing

------------------------------------------------
-- BOTÃO WEB ZIP
------------------------------------------------

local btnZip = Instance.new("ImageButton")

btnZip.Name = "BtnZip"

btnZip.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(75,75)

btnZip.Position =
	UDim2.new(0.79,0,0.63,0)

btnZip.BackgroundColor3 =
	Color3.fromRGB(190,25,25)

btnZip.Image =
	"rbxassetid://87791451477905"

btnZip.ScaleType =
	Enum.ScaleType.Fit

btnZip.Parent = gui

local zipCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

zipCorner.CornerRadius =
	UDim.new(1,0)

zipCorner.Parent = btnZip

local zipStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")

zipStroke.Color =
	Color3.fromRGB(0,110,255)

zipStroke.Thickness = 4

zipStroke.Parent = btnZip

------------------------------------------------
-- DETECTAR PAREDE
------------------------------------------------

local function getWall()

	local char, hrp = getParts()

	local params = RaycastParams.new()

	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {char}

	params.IgnoreWater = true

	local directions = {
		hrp.CFrame.LookVector,
		-hrp.CFrame.LookVector,
		hrp.CFrame.RightVector,
		-hrp.CFrame.RightVector
	}

	local closestResult = nil
	local closestDistance = math.huge

	for _, direction in ipairs(directions) do

		local result = Workspace:Raycast(
			hrp.Position,
			direction * 3.5,
			params
		)

		if result then

			local distance =
				(result.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude

			if distance < closestDistance then
				closestDistance = distance
				closestResult = result
			end
		end
	end

	return closestResult
end

------------------------------------------------
-- PARAR ESCALADA
------------------------------------------------

local function stopClimb()

	if not climbing then
		return
	end

	climbing = false

	if climbConn then
		climbConn:Disconnect()
		climbConn = nil
	end

	if climbTrack then
		if climbTrack.IsPlaying then
			climbTrack:Stop(0.15)
		end

		climbTrack = nil
	end

	if climbVelocity then
		climbVelocity:Destroy()
		climbVelocity = nil
	end

	if climbAlign then
		climbAlign:Destroy()
		climbAlign = nil
	end

	if climbAttachment then
		climbAttachment:Destroy()
		climbAttachment = nil
	end

	local char, hrp, hum = getParts()

	hum.AutoRotate = true
	hum.PlatformStand = false

	hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
end

------------------------------------------------
-- COMEÇAR ESCALADA
------------------------------------------------

local function startClimb()

	if climbing or not climbEnabled then
		return
	end

	local char, hrp, hum = getParts()

	local wall = getWall()

	if not wall then
		return
	end

	climbing = true

	hum.AutoRotate = false
	hum.PlatformStand = false

	------------------------------------------------
	-- ANIMAÇÃO DE ESCALADA R15
	------------------------------------------------

	local animator = getAnimator(hum)

	local anim = Instance.new("Animation")

	anim.AnimationId =
		CLIMB_ANIM

	climbTrack =
		animator:LoadAnimation(anim)

	climbTrack.Priority =
		Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4

	climbTrack.Looped = true

	climbTrack:Play(0.1)

	-- FORÇA O HUMANOID PARA O ESTADO DE ESCALADA
	hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing)

	------------------------------------------------
	-- CONTROLE DE VELOCIDADE
	------------------------------------------------

	climbAttachment =
		Instance.new("Attachment")

	climbAttachment.Name =
		"SpiderClimbAttachment"

	climbAttachment.Parent = hrp

	climbVelocity =
		Instance.new("LinearVelocity")

	climbVelocity.Name =
		"SpiderClimbVelocity"

	climbVelocity.MaxForce =
		math.huge

	climbVelocity.RelativeTo =
		Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World

	climbVelocity.VectorVelocity =
		Vector3.zero

	climbVelocity.Attachment0 =
		climbAttachment

	climbVelocity.Parent = hrp

	------------------------------------------------
	-- ORIENTAÇÃO
	------------------------------------------------

	climbAlign =
		Instance.new("AlignOrientation")

	climbAlign.Name =
		"SpiderClimbOrientation"

	climbAlign.Mode =
		Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment

	climbAlign.MaxTorque =
		math.huge

	climbAlign.Responsiveness =
		25

	climbAlign.RigidityEnabled =
		false

	climbAlign.Attachment0 =
		climbAttachment

	climbAlign.Parent = hrp

	------------------------------------------------
	-- CONTROLE
	------------------------------------------------

	climbConn =
		RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()

			if not climbing then
				return
			end

			if not hrp.Parent then
				stopClimb()
				return
			end

			local currentWall = getWall()

			if not currentWall then
				stopClimb()
				return
			end

			local normal =
				currentWall.Normal

			------------------------------------------------
			-- CÂMERA
			------------------------------------------------

			local camera =
				Workspace.CurrentCamera

			local cameraForward =
				camera.CFrame.LookVector

			local cameraRight =
				camera.CFrame.RightVector

			------------------------------------------------
			-- MOVIMENTO DO JOYSTICK
			------------------------------------------------

			local move =
				hum.MoveDirection

			local horizontal =
				Vector3.new(
					move.X,
					0,
					move.Z
				)

			local vertical =
				0

			if horizontal.Magnitude > 0.05 then

				local forwardAmount =
					horizontal:Dot(cameraForward)

				vertical =
					forwardAmount
			end

			------------------------------------------------
			-- MOVIMENTO NA PAREDE
			------------------------------------------------

			local up =
				Vector3.new(0,1,0)

			local wallRight =
				cameraRight

			wallRight =
				wallRight
				- normal * wallRight:Dot(normal)

			if wallRight.Magnitude > 0.01 then
				wallRight =
					wallRight.Unit
			end

			local climbUp =
				up * vertical * 8

			local climbSide =
				wallRight
				* move:Dot(wallRight)
				* 8

			local velocity =
				climbUp + climbSide

			------------------------------------------------
			-- MANTER NO PAREDÃO
			------------------------------------------------

			velocity +=
				-normal * 3

			climbVelocity.VectorVelocity =
				velocity

			------------------------------------------------
			-- VIRAR PARA A PAREDE
			------------------------------------------------

			local facing =
				-normal

			local look =
				Vector3.new(
					facing.X,
					0,
					facing.Z
				)

			if look.Magnitude > 0.01 then

				climbAlign.CFrame =
					CFrame.lookAt(
						Vector3.zero,
						look.Unit
					)
			end

			------------------------------------------------
			-- MANTER ESTADO DE ESCALADA
			------------------------------------------------

			if hum:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing then
				hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing)
			end
		end)
end

------------------------------------------------
-- BOTÃO DE ESCALADA
------------------------------------------------

btnClimb.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()

	climbEnabled =
		not climbEnabled

	if climbEnabled then

		local wall = getWall()

		if wall then
			startClimb()
		end

	else

		stopClimb()

	end
end)

------------------------------------------------
-- PARAR BALANÇO
------------------------------------------------

local function stopSwing()

	if not swinging then
		return
	end

	swinging = false

	if swingConn then
		swingConn:Disconnect()
		swingConn = nil
	end

	if swingTrack then
		if swingTrack.IsPlaying then
			swingTrack:Stop(0.2)
		end
	end

	clearIK()
	clearWebs()

	local char, hrp, hum = getParts()

	hum.PlatformStand = false
	hum.JumpPower = 100

	if swingRope then
		swingRope:Destroy()
		swingRope = nil
	end

	if swingAnchor then
		swingAnchor:Destroy()
		swingAnchor = nil
	end

	gripAtt = nil

	swingStep += 1

	if swingStep > 3 then
		swingStep = 1
	end
end

------------------------------------------------
-- COMEÇAR BALANÇO
------------------------------------------------

local function startSwing()

	if swinging then
		return
	end

	swinging = true

	local char, hrp, hum = getParts()

	hum.PlatformStand = true

	local animator = getAnimator(hum)

	if not swingTrack then

		local anim = Instance.new("Animation")

		anim.AnimationId = SWING_ANIM

		swingTrack =
			animator:LoadAnimation(anim)

		swingTrack.Priority =
			Enum.AnimationPriority.Action

		swingTrack.Looped = true
	end

	swingTrack:Play(0.15)

	playSound(hrp, SWING_SOUND)

	------------------------------------------------
	-- PONTO DA TEIA
	------------------------------------------------

	swingAnchor = Instance.new("Part")

	swingAnchor.Name = "WebAnchor"

	swingAnchor.Anchored = true
	swingAnchor.CanCollide = false
	swingAnchor.Transparency = 1

	swingAnchor.Size =
		Vector3.new(0.2,0.2,0.2)

	swingAnchor.Position =
		hrp.Position
		+ hrp.CFrame.LookVector * 36
		+ Vector3.new(0,13,0)

	swingAnchor.Parent = Workspace

	local a0 =
		Instance.new("Attachment")

	a0.Parent = swingAnchor

	local a1 =
		Instance.new("Attachment")

	a1.Parent = hrp

	swingRope =
		Instance.new("RopeConstraint")

	swingRope.Attachment0 = a0
	swingRope.Attachment1 = a1

	swingRope.Length =
		(swingAnchor.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude

	swingRope.Visible = false

	swingRope.Parent = hrp

	if swingStep == 1 then

		addWebFromHand(char,a0,"Right")
		attachArm(char,hum,"Right",a0)

	elseif swingStep == 2 then

		addWebFromHand(char,a0,"Left")
		attachArm(char,hum,"Left",a0)

	else

		addWebFromHand(char,a0,"Right")
		addWebFromHand(char,a0,"Left")

		attachArm(char,hum,"Right",a0)
		attachArm(char,hum,"Left",a0)

	end

	hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity +=
		hrp.CFrame.LookVector * 48

	swingConn =
		RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()

			if not swinging then
				return
			end

			if not hrp.Parent or not swingAnchor.Parent then
				return
			end

			local offset =
				swingAnchor.Position - hrp.Position

			if offset.Magnitude < 0.1 then
				return
			end

			local dir =
				offset.Unit

			local vel =
				hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity

			local radial =
				dir * vel:Dot(dir)

			hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
				(vel - radial)
				+ Vector3.new(
					0,
					-Workspace.Gravity * 0.03,
					0
				)
		end)
end

------------------------------------------------
-- WEB ZIP
------------------------------------------------

btnZip.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()

	stopSwing()

	local char, hrp, hum = getParts()

	local sides

	if zipStep == 1 then
		sides = {"Right"}

	elseif zipStep == 2 then
		sides = {"Left"}

	else
		sides = {"Right","Left"}
	end

	local tip = Instance.new("Part")

	tip.Name = "WebZipTarget"

	tip.Anchored = true
	tip.CanCollide = false
	tip.Transparency = 1

	tip.Size =
		Vector3.new(0.2,0.2,0.2)

	tip.Position =
		hrp.Position
		+ hrp.CFrame.LookVector * 34
		+ Vector3.new(0,12,0)

	tip.Parent = Workspace

	local tipAtt =
		Instance.new("Attachment")

	tipAtt.Parent = tip

	for _, side in ipairs(sides) do

		addWebFromHand(
			char,
			tipAtt,
			side
		)

		attachArm(
			char,
			hum,
			side,
			tipAtt
		)
	end

	playSound(hrp, ZIP_SOUND)

	local push =
		Instance.new("BodyVelocity")

	push.MaxForce =
		Vector3.new(
			1e7,
			1e7,
			1e7
		)

	push.Velocity =
		hrp.CFrame.LookVector * 120
		+ Vector3.new(0,55,0)

	push.Parent = hrp

	Debris:AddItem(tip,0.32)
	Debris:AddItem(push,0.28)

	task.delay(0.32,function()

		clearWebs()
		clearIK()

	end)

	zipStep += 1

	if zipStep > 3 then
		zipStep = 1
	end
end)

------------------------------------------------
-- CONTROLES
------------------------------------------------

btnSwing.MouseButton1Down:Connect(
	startSwing
)

btnSwing.MouseButton1Up:Connect(
	stopSwing
)

btnSwing.MouseLeave:Connect(
	stopSwing
)

------------------------------------------------
-- RESPAWN
------------------------------------------------

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()

	if swinging then
		stopSwing()
	end

	if climbing then
		stopClimb()
	end

	climbEnabled = false

	swingStep = 1
	zipStep = 1

end)
